_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); beverage and convenient-food signals

pit_profile.why: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food, snack and beverage company'; 'Our businesses operate in highly competitive markets', 'In U.S. measured channels, our chief beverage competitor, The Coca-Cola Company, has a larger share of CSD (carbonated soft drinks) consumption, while we have a larger share of liquid refreshment beverages consumption', and 'In addition, The Coca-Cola Company has a significant CSD share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2009 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food, snack and beverage company'; 'Our businesses operate in highly competitive markets', 'In U.S. measured channels, our chief beverage competitor, The Coca-Cola Company, has a larger share of CSD (carbonated soft drinks) consumption, while we have a larger share of liquid refreshment beverages consumption', and 'In addition, The Coca-Cola Company has a significant CSD share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2009 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.15x; -2% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +2.27; conservative 2yr +129%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -8.9%/yr (worst year FY00-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +38.4%/yr (Q2 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +38.4%/yr (FY00-FY09 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +38.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY00-FY09); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PEP (retrospective, 2010-09-24) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.15x (22.9% downside to Bear $51 / +154.0% upside to Bull $168) | Adj composite 3.60 vs market 1.33: gap +2.27 [UNDERVALUED] | -3% above the EPP floor $68 (18x FY10E $3.77) | Conservative 2-yr case: +128.8% total (+64.4%/yr) | At 17.5x FY10E the 15% hurdle price $87 sits at or below the BASE case; servings +7.0% in Q2 2010, forward revenues +37% (Q2 2010 net revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
